scope: read-only train-fit RGB visibility, identity, causality, and CPU cost audit

deployment.execution_frequency: every arrived RGB frame, including frames in windows later skipped by the scheduler
deployment.candidate_deadline: history ends at min(last real frame, candidate start + 8), identical to K
deployment.causal_inputs: same-frame RGB plus same-frame HRNet hand points; no temporal fill
deployment.cpu_gpu_transfer: none for descriptor; CPU float vector may be appended to the scheduler input
deployment.approximate_dct_arithmetic_per_frame: 393216 MACs for six separable 32x32 2-D DCTs, excluding decode/crop resize
deployment.pose_detector_cost: not included; K already requires the same online pose stream
deployment.risk: continuous PNG/RGB decode and pose inference remain mandatory and can offset saved ISLR windows

forbidden_rejected.reason: these are unavailable before the scheduler decision or are outcome leakage

encoder.name: fixed-ycrcb-dct-v1
encoder.normalization: RGB uint8 -> YCrCb float32 / 255; orthonormal OpenCV DCT
